system.description:
The toxins in your vitae grow potent enough to melt flesh, living or undead, burning through any wound the poison can reach while leaving other materials untouched.

Spend a turn transforming your vitae into poison and apply it to an object or weapon of dagger-size or larger. Each Blood Trait placed on a bladed or piercing weapon makes its next successful strike inflict aggravated damage — three Traits on a knife means the next three penetrating hits are aggravated. The weapon must actually break the victim's flesh; blunt weapons and unarmed strikes do not carry it, and it cannot be applied to bullets. The blood must be deliberately placed and must enter the target's system to have any effect — you cannot simply bleed on someone to harm them.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
